Dye affects the entire staff except the two end sections. The default color can be closely replicated using brown dye. {{dye chart|Bo Staff}} ==Replica== Except for the visual appearance and [[damage type]], it is possible to create a replica of this staff with the same stats. Replicas will cause the damage type associated with the inherent [[attribute]]. Create a replica with the following: *One of the following staves with the appropriate attribute: **[[Destroyer Staff]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]] **[[Imperial Staff]] from collector [[Shen Xi]] **[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]] *[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]] *Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]] OR *One of the following staves with the appropriate attribute: **[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]] **[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Weapon Master]] **[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] **[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]] **[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]] **[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]] **[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]] **Staff from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Soros]], or [[Sende]] *Perfect Insightful Staff Head *Perfect Staff Wrapping of Fortitude *Perfect [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription ==Unique counterparts== *[[Staff of the Forgotten (unique)]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts the damage type and requires the [[attribute]] associated with the version. *[[Bohdalz's Fury]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Lightning damage]] and requires [[Channeling Magic]]. *[[Bohdabi's Spire]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Cold damage]] and requires [[Death Magic]]. *[[Staff of Despair]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Chaos damage]] and requires [[Domination Magic]]. *[[Staff of the Kinslayer]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Dark damage]] and requires [[Soul Reaping]]. *[[The Mindclouder]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts Chaos damage and requires [[Illusion Magic]]. *[[Alem's Remedy]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts Dark damage and requires [[Restoration Magic]]. ==Notes== *Except for Divine Favor staves, [[Staff#Damage types of other staves|non-randomly generated]] Fast Casting, Soul Reaping, Energy Storage, and Spawning Power staves do not usually deal fire damage.
